name: Nuvemshop
description: Nuvemshop for Claude makes managing your store as easy as having a conversation. Connect your existing store in seconds and chat to create products, update inventory and prices, launch promotions and coupons, check recent orders, view customer data, or review shipping and payment methods, all without opening the admin.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Nuvemshop to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Nuvemshop to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://admin-mcp.nuvemshop.com.br/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Nuvemshop MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nuvemshop lists 28 MCP tools, including assign_categories, bulk_delete_products, create_category, create_coupon, create_product, create_promotion, delete_category, delete_coupon, delete_product, delete_promotion, get_coupon_details, and get_free_shipping_promotions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Nuvemshop?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Nuvemshop in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Nuvemshop requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Nuvemshop is developed by Nuvemshop  / Tiendanube. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
